title: Google Open Buildings 2.5D Temporal 2023 AOI crop
data_type: model-derived building presence/count/height raster, not RGB imagery
license_status: Dataset page states CC BY 4.0 and ODbL v1.0 options.
actual_AOI_query: GCS manifest token 31, EPSG:32648, year 2023; four intersecting COG tile URLs recorded in QA.
visual_only_vs_survey_use: usable as model-derived building raster supplement; not measured survey height and not RGB detail
limits: Training high-resolution imagery is not publicly released; model uses Sentinel-2 stacks. 0.5 m file grid must not be described as 0.5 m optical imagery. Height MAE was reported from Global North validation and is not a Gia Lộc accuracy guarantee. The 4 m crop has actual derived bounds recorded in QA; it trims a subpixel south/east border and must not be described as exact full-subpixel AOI coverage.
next_action: Use as optional building presence/height layer after Contractor synthesis; do not present as sharper optical basemap.

title: Planet Tropical Forest Observatory and historical NICFI Tropical Asia basemaps
imagery_date: Historical NICFI/GEE collection listed 2015-2025; current TFO AOI imagery dates not verified.
license_status: Current Planet Tropical Forest Observatory page describes non-commercial conservation access; operational government/business use should contact sales. Historical NICFI contract period ended January 23, 2025 while a new phase was being developed.
actual_AOI_query: https://api.planet.com/basemaps/v1/mosaics?api_key=&name__contains=planet_medres_normalized_analytic returned credentials required; no signup or qualification was attempted.
free_export_status: not_unconditional_free_rgb_for_rtr_city_demo; restricted non-commercial conservation or sales route
visual_only_vs_survey_use: potential visual basemap only after eligibility/EULA or sales license; not a surveyed orthophoto and no AOI asset verified here
limits: Current TFO page mentions 70,000 processing units per month, but that does not prove AOI asset availability or operational government/business entitlement. No signup, qualification claim, or export was made.
next_action: If the project has a qualifying conservation/non-commercial use, apply through TFO and verify AOI mosaic dates/terms. For RtR operational government/business city-demo use, contact Planet sales or use another licensed procurement route.
